windows.notes:
- Fixed rewrites that finished but showed "Paste didn't land" even though Ctrl+V worked by hand, most often in Microsoft Teams and other Electron or WebView2 apps. Refract once again sends one guarded Ctrl+V when the box can only be read by keystrokes, and no longer waits for the mouse and keyboard to stay still while the model works.
- When Refract cannot read the box back, it now says the paste was sent and could not be confirmed, instead of reporting a failure. It still never pastes twice.

Windows-only release. Compiled and checked with the Windows self-tests that run on macOS; paste behavior follows installation.

mac.notes: Mac notch hover now reveals the prism nearby, keeps the icon aligned with its handle, and adds tiny completion confetti. The plan window refreshes billing status and explains existing Pro access. Functional and visual testing follows installation.

linux.notes: Refract 2.0.0: new Settings and Home, badges and levels, presets and app rules, themes, insights, rewrites that do not fail, a notch handle that stays hidden until you reach for it, light strips on Windows and Linux. Full notes in docs/releases/2.0.0.md
